entities.summary: Gavriil Vasilyevich Baranovsky, also Baranovskii was a Russian architect, civil engineer, art historian and publisher, who worked primarily in Saint Petersburg for the Elisseeff family, but also practiced in Moscow and produced the first town plan for Murmansk.
